note: Offers, and the beats that follow them: the same shape as plot.json. 'when' holds an offer's conditions (met_days: days he has met them; visits: days he has been in a place; known: people he has met; since_day: days since day 1; cash_below, cash_min; flags (each must equal its value); flags_in (a flag must be one of a list of values, null in the list accepting it unset); flags_not (a flag must not be a value or any of a list of values; unset passes unless null is listed); wardrobe: a garment he still owns; words: a manuscript of that many words; on: one date; owes: a cost he owes and his cash cannot meet; cheques: cheques he holds; days: days of the week). Effects, in a beat or in a choice's yes or no: pay (money to him now, or after_min later, at a place 'at', or at his next sitting of 'write' words), cheque (the same, but a cheque he cannot bank), owe, sell (a garment, and what it fetches where 'at'), schedule (a standing engagement with 'days', or an appointment in_days for a beat that follows), reprice (a debt that stands owed is changed), bank (an account: cheques then clear in three days), commission (work that recurs every N days, one piece asked for at a time). A pay with 'flag' sets that flag when it is paid. 'again_days': a refused offer comes back after that many days. owes_none: none of these costs may stand owed or fall due at that moment; net_min: cash less all he owes and all that falls due at that moment. A choice branch's 'reopens' lets the named offers be made again. 'switch': the offer exists only while that switch is on (ramesh_days: HEGEL_RAMESH_DAYS).  HEGEL_EXITS adds: running (an engagement kept, with that many sessions held), fired_before (a beat fired on an earlier day), due_within (a cost falls due within that many days, and his cash is below it), plain_days (the kitchen on the plain meal for that many days); 'like': an offer made as another is, with its own words and conditions; a schedule may be a list; 'feed' (a meal given him by a person of the house); 'repeat': with again_days, an offer taken may come again too. piece_out (a piece of his that went out, a talk given or a piece paid for, at least after_days ago and not yet thanked, and no gift in the last gap_days); 'gift': an envelope with that sum, its words filled with the piece it names, which may come again; a pay's 'ask' stays on his mind until the piece is written. Every offer is made by someone present; every price is simulated.
